raw_transcript: Well, um, on the fictional Aster dashboard I helped Ellis Snow, our accessibility tester, inspect keyboard navigation. We checked 14 controls in Firefox at 200% zoom. Three controls had no visible focus indicator. I added CSS outlines to those 3 and verified that Tab reached them in the expected sequence. I have not checked screen reader announcements, and this was not a full WCAG audit. The chart still relies on color alone to distinguish 2 series. I opened issue AST-18 for that instead of trying a rushed palette change. Ellis will review the patch on Monday. I want the journal to say what was actually tested, not that the whole dashboard is accessible now.
